          About this item

          • Advanced 3-in-1 Filtration: Cleanable pre-filter captures dust and pet hair; certified HEPA filter removes up to 99.97% of allergens; carbon filter reduces odors and VOCs
          • 360° Airflow with Turbo360 Fan: Swivel fan and spin mode distribute HEPA-filtered air evenly across large rooms up to 1928 sq. ft.
          • Smart Air Quality Monitoring: Built-in air quality sensor with real-time color-coded display adjusts performance based on indoor air conditions
          • Custom Comfort Settings: Three fan positions, sleep mode with dimmed lights, and timer options (2, 4, 8 hours) for personalized use
          • Quiet Operation for Bedrooms: Low-noise design ideal for bedrooms, nurseries, or home offices; AHAM Verifide for 398 sq. ft. at 4.8 ACH

          Product Description

          The Honeywell Allergen Plus HPA6000 3-in-1 HEPA Air Purifier, Fan, and Circulator is engineered to improve indoor air quality in large rooms. With a powerful Turbo360™ swivel fan and 360° air circulation, it delivers HEPA-filtered air across spaces up to 1928 sq. ft. at 1 air change per hour. Its three-stage filtration system includes a cleanable pre-filter for dust and pet hair, a certified HEPA filter that captures up to 99.97% of airborne allergens like pollen and smoke, and a carbon filter that helps reduce odors and VOCs in the air like household cleaners and air fresheners. Designed for year-round comfort, the HPA6000 features intuitive air quality monitoring, a capacitive touch panel, and a quiet sleep mode. Whether you're managing allergy season, wildfire smoke, or everyday indoor pollutants, this air purifier is ideal for bedrooms, living rooms, and home offices. AHAM verified for 398 sq. ft. with 4.8 air changes per hour, it’s a reliable solution for cleaner, fresher air. These units are independently tested and include a 5-year limited warranty. With Honeywell Air Purifiers, you can trust the air you breathe.

          How customer reviews and ratings work

          Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

          To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

          Amazon Customer
          5 out of 5 stars
          Fantastic air purifier
          I love how easy this was to put together. It's light, and the air filter is a 3 stage--one for big dust bunnies that you can easily pull out and vacuum. The second stage is carbon filter, and finally a HEPA filter. All 3 stages are built into one cannister for easy replacement and feature a rubber type grommet on top and bottom to seal any air from getting around the filter. It's a Honeywell, a name brand that equals quality for decades! There's an automatic function and a timer function which I really like both of those settings. If you choose a manual speed setting, the first speed is whisper quiet. Second speed is a little audible, and the third speed you'll really know that it's running. It's comparable to a room fan on high. But the majority of the time, it stays on the lowest speed. Now...for the coolest part--how the fan pivots and distributes air. You can point it straight up towards the ceiling and it will distribute the air kind of like a ceiling fan. Or you can set it like an old school pedestal fan that gently sweeps left to right. OR my favorite is to have it circulate 360 degrees at all times. At first, I stared at this for several minutes unable to understand how the wires inside don't twist up. Then I got it--the fan is below, and the grill is simply on top rotating--genius, and fun to look at. Air cleaning specs--remember, the highest number advertised is for the highest speed, and is measured in SQUARE feet. Which all air purifiers do because it's easy to puff up ratings. Air filtration is scientifically measured in CUBIC feet. So check out the ratings, they're on the box, but the fine print still leaves impressive numbers and I'm satisified for using it in our bedroom. Leaving it on high still gives impressive air changes per hour. I also have an impressive (and expensive) RabbitAir for the main living room but we felt it wasn't covering the whole house. This Honeywell fits PERFECT for our upstairs bedroom. The sensor is working well and easily picks up when we walk by, evident of our dusty carpet that we don't vacuum enough. When that happens, the light changes to yellow or red (in my picture) and it adjusts speed accordingly, if we set it to AUTO. In the morning, when I leave the room, I set it on 2 hour timer, and it takes care of the "morning breath" in the room.

          About this Item

          • Advanced 3-in-1 Filtration: Cleanable pre-filter captures dust and pet hair; certified HEPA filter removes up to 99.97% of allergens; carbon filter reduces odors and VOCs
          • 360° Airflow with Turbo360 Fan: Swivel fan and spin mode distribute HEPA-filtered air evenly across large rooms up to 1928 sq. ft.
          • Smart Air Quality Monitoring: Built-in air quality sensor with real-time color-coded display adjusts performance based on indoor air conditions
          • Custom Comfort Settings: Three fan positions, sleep mode with dimmed lights, and timer options (2, 4, 8 hours) for personalized use
          • Quiet Operation for Bedrooms: Low-noise design ideal for bedrooms, nurseries, or home offices; AHAM Verifide for 398 sq. ft. at 4.8 ACH

          Product Description

          The Honeywell Allergen Plus HPA6000 3-in-1 HEPA Air Purifier, Fan, and Circulator is engineered to improve indoor air quality in large rooms. With a powerful Turbo360™ swivel fan and 360° air circulation, it delivers HEPA-filtered air across spaces up to 1928 sq. ft. at 1 air change per hour. Its three-stage filtration system includes a cleanable pre-filter for dust and pet hair, a certified HEPA filter that captures up to 99.97% of airborne allergens like pollen and smoke, and a carbon filter that helps reduce odors and VOCs in the air like household cleaners and air fresheners. Designed for year-round comfort, the HPA6000 features intuitive air quality monitoring, a capacitive touch panel, and a quiet sleep mode. Whether you're managing allergy season, wildfire smoke, or everyday indoor pollutants, this air purifier is ideal for bedrooms, living rooms, and home offices. AHAM verified for 398 sq. ft. with 4.8 air changes per hour, it’s a reliable solution for cleaner, fresher air. These units are independently tested and include a 5-year limited warranty. With Honeywell Air Purifiers, you can trust the air you breathe.
